package_info.why_malicious: The report does not describe a specific malicious software package or code snippet. Instead, it discusses the general risk and real-world impact of software supply chain attacks, referencing the Equifax breach (via Apache Struts vulnerability) and the broader trend of adversaries injecting vulnerabilities into open source components. No concrete package or code is identified for extraction.

behavioral_signatures: Rapid exploitation of newly disclosed open source vulnerabilities
Injection of malicious code or vulnerabilities into open source projects
Scanning for unpatched servers immediately after vulnerability disclosure
file_indicators: Use of outdated or vulnerable open source components (e.g., Apache Struts with known CVEs)
network_indicators: Automated scanning activity targeting known-vulnerable endpoints
Unusual outbound connections following exploitation of a vulnerable component
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for use of open source components with recently disclosed vulnerabilities, especially in production environments. Detect automated scanning or exploitation attempts targeting these components within hours of public disclosure. Implement software composition analysis (SCA) to identify and remediate vulnerable dependencies. Watch for abnormal outbound network activity from applications using such components.
